existing_proofs_preserved: Complete per-batch masked gather, sign-selected repetition operation, count-frequency subtraction, presence subtraction and in-place scatter are proved, including termination, bounds and off-write frame. The Real IO retains explicit write-map injectivity for token-address values; reciprocal candidate equivalence carries an explicit division rule.

production_stage_mapping.coverage: The complete gather-transform-scatter body and positive/nonpositive logits branch are represented.
Contiguity assertion, next-power-of-two/minimum block cases and batch grid are not composed into a public in-place wrapper contract.

dtype_review: Formal logits/penalty buffers are Region.real and token/count/length buffers Region.nat. Original tensors choose storage independently; no typed promotion/store family or exact valid nonnegative metadata representation is connected to these public parameters.
branch_review: The tl.where positive/nonpositive branch and active-token mask are already present. BLOCK<=512, <=1024 and larger cases plus the assertion failure are host branches absent from public scope. Duplicate token safety is not demanded beyond the legitimate existing injective valid-input domain.

structural_gaps.finding: Original wrapper asserts contiguous logits and chooses BLOCK via next_power_of_2 and two thresholds before all-batch launch.
structural_gaps.why_blocks_full_original_scope: The per-batch IO theorem is not a composition theorem for this exact in-place wrapper and its admitted/error branches.

structural_gaps.finding: Current source model fixes mathematical real and Nat regions, whereas original loads tensor-dependent logits, penalties, counts and token indices.
structural_gaps.why_blocks_full_original_scope: The exact storage/promotion and valid metadata-to-Nat binding are unrepresented structural routes; arithmetic deferrals alone cannot complete them.

numerical_items_eligible_for_explicit_de: Division/multiplication, subtraction and count conversion rounding may be explicitly deferred once exact source type/case bindings are present. The sign branch itself is already modeled and must not be removed.
precondition_assessment: The existing bounds, nonoverlap, positive tile size and valid-address premises are legitimate selected-domain assumptions. No unrestricted invalid-input behavior or hypothetical hardware defect is demanded. Missing wrapper composition and dtype admission are separate structural questions.
